Title: Beat, my Still Heart
Body: You wonder what would happen if your heart started beating again, and start thinking of ways to jump-start it.
Narrative 1: I tried to jump-start my heart again by beating my chest repeatedly. The only thing that happened was my chest hurt for <num3-7> days.
Narrative 2: I tried to jump-start my heart again by <sticking a metal fork in an outlet/grabbing a live wire/jumping into a electrical plant>. All I did was fry my skin.

Narrative 4: I opened up an ancient tome and recited the words within it to see if a spell could restart my heart, but all it did was summon a demon who retrieved hearts for me.

Title: Now You See Me
Body: You wonder why, scientifically speaking, vampires can't see their own reflection and decide to run some experiments to figure it out.
Narrative 1: I stood in front of different reflective surfaces to understand why vampires can't see their own reflection, but the results were inconclusive.
Narrative 2: I splattered some of my blood on different reflective surfaces to understand why vampires can't see their own reflections, but it disappeared on contact.
Narrative 3: I wore the skin of one of my victims to test why vampires can't see their own reflections. The results were both inconclusive and horrifying.
Narrative 4: I stood between several mirrors to test why vampires can't see their own reflections. The results were inconclusive and left me with a migraine.
